agent.summary:
The `rate` service is working again. Its pod is now `1/1 Running`.

**Cause:** The `rate` pod was crash-looping with "SASL authentication failed". `mongodb-rate` runs with `--auth`, and its `admin` user (the one `rate` logs in as) no longer existed. The MongoDB log showed `UserNotFound: admin`.

**Fix:**
- I ran the existing `/scripts/remove-mitigate-admin-rate-mongo.sh` inside the `mongodb-rate` pod. It recreated `admin` with the `userAdminAnyDatabase` role and granted it `readWrite` on `rate-db`.
- I deleted the crash-looping `rate` pod so it restarted straight away instead of waiting out the back-off.

I didn't send any test requests through the application. I only checked that the pod came up and stayed running.
